name: Godot asset_placer
description: Publish selected assets into a Godot project's asset_placer library, creating or merging its asset_library.json so the dock sees them.

exporter.name: placer
exporter.summary: Publish models into a Godot project's asset_placer library, creating or merging its asset_library.json.

options.name: format
options.help: Per-asset file: a merged .glb, or a loose .gltf copy with its .bin and textures.

options.name: sub-dir
options.help: Project subfolder, relative to --to; also the res:// prefix of each asset's id.

options.name: library-json
options.help: The addon's asset_library.json to create or merge.
